runs.answer:
UNVERIFIED EVALUATION BASELINE

The supplied evidence does not contain any experiment results specific to OPT-1.3B, so a comparison of OPT-1.3B experiments cannot be supported. [e6a6145e-fcc6-4a57-9542-5b44360efee5] [d24dc815-87ae-4607-88b2-ae9968e3467b]

The only model-specific experiment described in the evidence is conducted with the OPT-6.7B model under INT3-g128 quantization, not OPT-1.3B. [e6a6145e-fcc6-4a57-9542-5b44360efee5]

In that OPT-6.7B experiment, using the same calibration and evaluation distribution works best (PubMed-PubMed, Enron-Enron). [e6a6145e-fcc6-4a57-9542-5b44360efee5]

When calibration and evaluation distributions differ (PubMed-Enron, Enron-PubMed), AWQ increases perplexity by only 0.5-0.6, while GPTQ shows 2.3-4.9 worse perplexity. [e6a6145e-fcc6-4a57-9542-5b44360efee5]

AWQ can reach good quantized performance with a calibration set 10× smaller than GPTQ's. [e6a6145e-fcc6-4a57-9542-5b44360efee5]

Because the reported evaluation conditions are tied to OPT-6.7B and INT3-g128 quantization, they cannot be used to characterize or compare OPT-1.3B evaluation conditions. [e6a6145e-fcc6-4a57-9542-5b44360efee5]
